meta.data: MASTER_FINAL_v13 (367 atlas plans; OAR cohort 12 patients, 48 distance points)
meta.brain: fitrgp ardsquaredexponential, Standardize, inputs [log(volume) central irregular], response log(brain)
meta.quality: fitrgp ardsquaredexponential, Standardize, inputs [log(volume) central irregular], response raw
meta.oar: fitrensemble Bag 500, MinLeafSize 2, NumVariablesToSample all; inputs [oar_dist chiasm contact_code volume srs24 fr3]

oar.rule: x >= cut goes to the next interval (MATLAB trees send x < cut left)
